notes:
Original p. 1080 prints entry percentages and Fisher exact p, but no OR or other named effect-size estimate for that test. Percentages retained as context; no metric conversion performed. Replication title verified against DOI landing metadata, OpenAlex and publisher listing. Publisher supplies abstract and truncated section snippets only; no full text accepted. Requested p. 8 cannot be checked. No numerical fields or replication verdict inferred from snippets. Acquisition stopped after DOI landing, Unpaywall, OpenAlex, Europe PMC, author-affiliated EfD listing, institutional repository and primary Mendeley file-listing attempts.
Source follow-up: Publisher journal pre-proof retained as supplied. Rendered PDF page 9 verifies target entry proportions and p < 0.001. No odds ratio printed for this unadjusted proportion test; es left null rather than deriving OR from 84/426 women and 183/428 men. p quote is the continuation of line-broken p-value.
Completion source review (n_o): Tables I and II explicitly document the forty-women/forty-men participant sample for the same Task-3 tournament-choice outcome. These mutually exclusive groups support the unconditional gender comparison; no exclusions are stated for that comparison.
